_comment: AI Director configuration, one block per AI nation. The AI sees everything (no fog of war for it).

Postures: DEFEND (hold the line, react to incursions, shuffle reserves), PROBE (mass on the trench line around a Schwerpunkt, probe no-man's-land), ASSAULT (armor-led flanking maneuver around the weaker Kestrian flank toward a rear objective, with pinning probes in the center).
tension 0-100 drifts each week by tension_drift[posture] + noise; inbox replies change it via the `ai_tension` effect.

DEFEND -> PROBE: tension >= probe_threshold (random). PROBE -> ASSAULT: tension >= assault_threshold after assault_min_probe_weeks (random). ASSAULT -> PROBE: tension < assault_break_threshold or assault_max_weeks elapsed. PROBE -> DEFEND: tension < defend_threshold.
Any posture -> DEFEND when Kestrian strength at/east of threat_line_x >= threat_ratio x Vosk strength in the front region.
Every posture first pulls back formations whose supply is below resupply_threshold and not SUPPLIED.
Coordinates: front_line_x / staging_x are map columns. Flank waypoints are [x, y] cells; the objective is the Kestrian HQ in objective_region if present, else a settlement there.
naval / air: see their _comment blocks. Coordinates follow data/map/world.json (240 x 80).

naval._comment: Fleets: return to harbour when supply < resupply_threshold; otherwise PATROL near home in DEFEND, and in PROBE/ASSAULT send submarines (and destroyers when no enemy fleet is near) to BLOCKADE the richest Kestrian port they can reach, and battle squadrons to BOMBARD coastal battles. Any fleet attacks a visible enemy fleet within hunt_range rows.

air._comment: Each week wings go to sectors with Vosk land battles (most engaged strength first), else the front sector.
